# Ana's personal brief

How Ana likes to work, in every project.
The person you work with keeps these in Memax. Where a project's own files disagree, follow the project.

## Preferences
- Answer in British English, in short paragraphs, with no emoji. [M-0101]
- Before writing more than a screen of code, say the plan in three lines. [M-0102]
- Search with `rg`, not `grep`. [M-0111]

## Conventions
- Commit messages are imperative and under 72 characters. [M-0103]
- (In conflict) Tabs in Go, two spaces everywhere else. [M-0108]

## Decisions
- (Being verified) New services default to Postgres 17. [M-0107]
- Use pnpm in every JavaScript project, never npm or yarn. [M-0106]

## Open questions
- Whether to keep work and personal Claude accounts apart. [M-0110]
